helmet: Two-wheeler riders and pillions must wear ISI-marked helmets.
seatbelt: Front and rear seat passengers must wear seat belts in cars.
red_light: Stop before the stop line when the signal is red. Do not cross.
yellow_light: Slow down and prepare to stop unless you cannot stop safely.
zebra_crossing: Give way to pedestrians at zebra crossings.
mobile_phone: Do not use a handheld phone while driving.
drunk_driving: Do not drive under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
overtaking: Overtake only when the road ahead is clear and it is legal to do so.
